description: False-positive control: a sub-resource controller dispatching one operation and handling both branches, and an operation returning a payload hash with routable failure codes. ADVISORY findings are acceptable; no MANDATORY finding is expected on these skills.
notes: The operation uses the helper signatures the operation-pattern skill documents (fail_with_code!(model, code, message:), fail_with_model!(model)); re-verify against app/concepts/core/operation.rb once it exists in the studio. Plain English strings are correct here: the studio has no i18n.
